name: Stellar Performance
author: SilentHacks
description:
Smoother ship-heavy worlds with live performance presets.

• Press F8 for Faithful, Balanced, Performance, Aggressive or Custom
• Cache ship bounds, cable topology and signal connections
• Rebuild rooms locally and reuse single-player room queries
• Batch fixed meshes and cull offscreen part UI
• Suppress identical supported replication payloads

Balanced keeps native presentation. Higher presets trade cosmetic detail for speed. Room gas rounding can differ slightly.

Requires Demo 0.8.2 and MelonLoader 0.7.3.
